content: No peer SCIP indexer does cross-run incremental indexing/caching. scip-typescript has --global-caches (in-process CompilerHost cache for parsed command lines + source files across tsconfig projects in a monorepo, NOT cross-invocation). rust-analyzer scip uses Salsa + prefill_caches:true but is a one-shot CLI loading the full workspace. scip-python does full Pyright analysis each run. All peers rebuild fully each invocation. Incremental indexing is NOT table stakes.
